title: Torque depends on the angle of the push
caption: τ = rF sin θ. Pushing the 0.25 m spanner with 30 N at 60° to the handle gives τ = 6.5 N m; pushing at 90° gives the most, 7.5 N m, and pushing along the handle gives none.
alt: Torque against the angle between force and spanner, a sine curve rising from zero to 7.5 newton metres at 90 degrees, with 6.5 marked at 60 degrees.
description: r = 0.25 m, F = 30 N, so rF = 7.5 N m.
At 90° the whole force is perpendicular to the handle and the torque is greatest; at 0° and 180° it is zero.
